Broken Spoke Monday Night Road Ride

Suamico, WI · Road

Broken Spoke Monday Night Road Ride is a road group ride in Suamico, WI. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Broken Spoke Bike Studio, Suamico. Pace: b group pace, 18–20 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train.
Check
Look at @brokenspokebicycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Broken Spoke Monday Night Road Ride group ride

A brisk Monday road ride from the Suamico shop north of Green Bay. Averages 18–20 mph. The shop also runs Wednesday night dirt rides at 5:30 on rotating trails and a Sunday 8 am coffee ride at a recovery pace.
